<!--
Solve one underlying problem per PR. Use a conventional commit title in plain language,
such as "fix(web): job list no longer flickers on reconnect".
-->

## Problem

<!-- The problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and reproduction steps where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes the problem. If it spans components or clients, say why each change is needed. -->

## Verification

<!-- The focused tests or manual checks you ran and what you observed. State anything you could
not check. "Tests pass" alone is not evidence.

For UI changes, include before and after screenshots, and a short recording when motion or timing
matters. Upload evidence to the PR; never commit PR-only assets. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
